answer: Graduated standing resists sybils: a fresh identity enters with heavily dampened weight and earns full influence only slowly across many honest epochs, so a new seat is near-powerless at first. A swarm spun up together all starts at the bottom; none reaches the summit of real influence until each pays real time. Standing accrues ring by ring like cedar, spiraling upward slowly — mass registration buys only a pile of empty, weightless accounts.
